title: UK English localisation baseline
summary: MyAPES Account now runs in UK English (en_GB) by default, with published framework messages, friendly validation field names, and written localisation conventions for the Language line.
changes: Set the application locale to en_GB (fallback en) in local env examples, CI, config defaults, and Cloudron production env guidance.
On Cloudron activate, upsert APP_LOCALE, APP_FALLBACK_LOCALE, and APP_FAKER_LOCALE so existing shared environments match the baseline.
Publish lang/en_GB framework files (auth, pagination, passwords, validation) with UK spelling and friendly validation attributes, keeping lang/en as fallback.
Add docs/localisation.md for key naming, plurals, placeholders, and plugin translation namespaces.
Align the HTML lang attribute with the app locale (en-GB) on primary layouts.
version_rationale: Minor bump opens the v0.38.x Language & keywords line: UK English localisation baseline without renaming live URLs or stored permission strings.
validation: PHPUnit LocalisationBaselineTest and DeploymentAuthenticationContractTest locale upsert coverage.
php artisan myapes:changelog-validate --base-ref=origin/main on the PR branch.
composer pre-pr-verify (or equivalent local verify) on the PR branch before merge.
known_limitations: Most user-facing copy remains hard-coded until later Language extraction waves.
Glossary, plugin translation namespaces, SEO, and user locale preference ship in later 0.38.x patches.
Display name / title chrome still says MyAPES Core until glossary and SEO waves.
rollback: Redeploy the previous Cloudron package (0.37.11). Locale env keys can be set back to en if needed; no database migrations ship in this release.
provenance: Language Wave 0 localisation baseline for issue #265, pull request #312.
